plugin.name: Inline_Image_Compatibility_Test
plugin.author: MUSHclient contributors
plugin.purpose: Check selection, copy, multiline triggers, resizing and miniwindows against a local image fixture

muclient.script:
local enabled, marker_seen, phase = false, false, 'waiting' local marker_time, multiline_hits, image_callbacks = 0, 0, 0 local before_line, image_line, after_line, end_line, wide_image_line local image_source, wide_source local prior_clipboard, miniwindow local fixture_ports = { ['Inline images - MXP test'] = 18766, ['Inline images - Pueblo test'] = 18767, } local output = GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 6) .. '.compat-results.txt' local function record(message) local f = assert(io.open(output, 'a')) f:write(message, '
'); f:close() end local function check(condition, message) record((condition and 'PASS ' or 'FAIL ') .. message) if not condition then error(message) end end local function safe_run(fn) local ok, err = pcall(fn) if not ok then record('ERROR ' .. tostring(err)) if prior_clipboard then SetClipboard(prior_clipboard) end phase = 'failed' end end function OnPluginInstall() local expected_port = fixture_ports[WorldName()] if not expected_port or GetAlphaOption('site') ~= '127.0.0.1' or GetOption('port') ~= expected_port then return end enabled = true local f = assert(io.open(output, 'w')); f:close() miniwindow = 'inline_compat_' .. GetPluginID() check(AddTriggerEx('compat_multiline', 'COMPAT_BEFORE[^
]*
COMPAT_AFTER[^
]*
', '', 41, -1, 0, '', 'OnCompatMultiline', 12, 100) == 0, 'multiline trigger installed before fixture output') check(SetTriggerOption('compat_multiline', 'multi_line', 'y') == 0 and SetTriggerOption('compat_multiline', 'lines_to_match', '2') == 0, 'multiline trigger spans two received text lines') record('START compatibility test') end function OnPluginConnect() if enabled then Send('compat') end end function OnCompatMultiline() multiline_hits = multiline_hits + 1 record('MULTILINE match=' .. tostring(GetRecentLines(2))) end function OnPluginLineReceived(line) if not enabled then return true end record('CALLBACK ' .. string.format('%q', line)) if line:find('^%[https?://') then image_callbacks = image_callbacks + 1 end if line:find('COMPAT_END', 1, true) then marker_seen, marker_time = true, os.time() end return true end local function scan_rows() local images = {} for line = 1, GetLinesInBufferCount() do local text = GetLineInfo(line, 1) if text:find('COMPAT_BEFORE', 1, true) then before_line = line end if text:find('COMPAT_AFTER', 1, true) then after_line = line end if text:find('COMPAT_END', 1, true) then end_line = line end if GetLineInfo(line, 14) then images[#images+1] = line end end image_line, wide_image_line = images[1], images[2] image_source = image_line and GetLineInfo(image_line, 15) wide_source = wide_image_line and GetLineInfo(wide_image_line, 15) return images end -- Reproduce the line/text/newline API usage of the bundled Copy_Output plugin. local function plugin_style_copy() local first, last = GetSelectionStartLine(), GetSelectionEndLine() local first_column, last_column = GetSelectionStartColumn(), GetSelectionEndColumn() local parts = {} for line = first, last do local info = GetLineInfo(line) if line < last then parts[#parts+1] = info.text:sub(first_column) if info.newline then parts[#parts+1] = '
' end first_column = 1 else parts[#parts+1] = info.text:sub(first_column, last_column-1) end end return table.concat(parts) end local function assert_row_geometry(message) check(GetLineInfo(after_line, 19) == GetLineInfo(image_line, 19) + GetLineInfo(image_line, 20), message) end function CaptureCompatibilityClipboard() if not enabled then return end local copied = GetClipboard() record(string.format('MANUAL clipboard length=%d tall_url=%s wide_url=%s', #copied, tostring(image_source and copied:find(image_source, 1, true) ~= nil), tostring(wide_source and copied:find(wide_source, 1, true) ~= nil))) record(string.format('MANUAL selection lines=%s..%s columns=%s..%s', tostring(GetSelectionStartLine()), tostring(GetSelectionEndLine()), tostring(GetSelectionStartColumn()), tostring(GetSelectionEndColumn()))) end function OnPluginTick() if not enabled or not marker_seen or phase == 'failed' or phase == 'done' then return end if phase == 'waiting' then if os.time() - marker_time < 4 then return end local images = scan_rows() if not image_line or not wide_image_line or GetLineInfo(image_line, 18) == 0 or GetLineInfo(wide_image_line, 18) == 0 then if os.time() - marker_time > 30 then record('FAIL compatibility image missing or still loading after 30 seconds') phase = 'failed' end return end safe_run(function() check(before_line and after_line and before_line < image_line and image_line < after_line, 'image remains between compatibility paragraphs') check(#images == 2 and GetLineInfo(image_line, 18) == 1 and GetLineInfo(wide_image_line, 18) == 1, 'compatibility fixture creates tall and wide loaded image rows') check(GetLineInfo(image_line, 17) == 4096, 'tall image preserves intrinsic height') check(GetLineInfo(image_line, 16) == 64 and GetLineInfo(wide_image_line, 16) == 640, 'fixture images preserve their different intrinsic widths') record(string.format('TRIGGERS hits=%d image_callbacks=%d recent=%q', multiline_hits, image_callbacks, tostring(GetRecentLines(6)))) check(multiline_hits == 1 and image_callbacks == 0, 'multiline trigger bridges image without synthetic text callbacks') check(GetLineInfo(image_line, 1):find(image_source, 1, true) ~= nil, 'plain-text image fallback contains the source URL') assert_row_geometry('paragraph below image follows displayed image bottom') check(end_line and GetLineInfo(end_line, 19) == GetLineInfo(wide_image_line, 19) + GetLineInfo(wide_image_line, 20), 'final marker follows wide image bottom')
check(WindowCreate(miniwindow, 0, 0, 140, 28, 5, 0, 0x202020) == 0 and WindowShow(miniwindow, true) == 0 and WindowInfo(miniwindow, 3) == 140 and WindowInfo(miniwindow, 5), 'plugin miniwindow coexists with image transcript') assert_row_geometry('miniwindows do not change transcript image layout')
SetSelection(before_line, end_line, 1, #GetLineInfo(end_line, 1)+1) check(GetSelectionStartLine() == before_line and GetSelectionEndLine() == end_line, 'selection spans text and both image rows') local reconstructed = plugin_style_copy() check(reconstructed:find('COMPAT_BEFORE', 1, true) and reconstructed:find(image_source, 1, true) and reconstructed:find(wide_source, 1, true) and reconstructed:find('COMPAT_AFTER', 1, true), 'Copy_Output-style plugin can reconstruct both image fallbacks') prior_clipboard = GetClipboard() check(DoCommand('Copy') == 0, 'plain copy command accepted') phase = 'plain_copy' end) elseif phase == 'plain_copy' then safe_run(function() local copied = GetClipboard() check(copied:find('COMPAT_BEFORE', 1, true) and copied:find(image_source, 1, true) and copied:find(wide_source, 1, true) and copied:find('COMPAT_AFTER', 1, true), 'plain copied selection contains both image URL fallbacks and paragraphs') check(DoCommand('CopyAsHTML') == 0, 'CopyAsHTML command accepted') phase = 'html_copy' end) elseif phase == 'html_copy' then safe_run(function() local copied = GetClipboard() local has_signature = copied:find('Produced by MUSHclient', 1, true) ~= nil local has_tall_url = copied:find(image_source, 1, true) ~= nil local has_wide_url = copied:find(wide_source, 1, true) ~= nil local has_after = copied:find('COMPAT_AFTER', 1, true) ~= nil record(string.format('HTML clipboard length=%d signature=%s tall_url=%s wide_url=%s after=%s', #copied, tostring(has_signature), tostring(has_tall_url), tostring(has_wide_url), tostring(has_after))) check(has_signature and has_tall_url and has_wide_url and has_after, 'HTML copy includes both readable image URL fallbacks') SetClipboard(prior_clipboard) prior_clipboard = nil MoveWorldWindow(40, 40, 1050, 500) local wide_height = GetLineInfo(image_line, 20) MoveWorldWindow(40, 40, 1050, 800) local taller_height = GetLineInfo(image_line, 20) check(taller_height > wide_height and wide_height > 100, 'height-only resize adjusts tall image to viewport cap') assert_row_geometry('height-only resize preserves following paragraph position')
MoveWorldWindow(40, 40, 1050, 500) Pause(true) SetScroll(120, true) local anchor_before = GetInfo(296) local image_top = GetLineInfo(image_line, 19) check(anchor_before > image_top and anchor_before < image_top + GetLineInfo(image_line, 20), 'paused scroll anchor falls inside the tall image row') MoveWorldWindow(40, 40, 1050, 800) local anchor_after = GetInfo(296) record(string.format('SCROLL paused resize before=%d after=%d image_top=%d', anchor_before, anchor_after, image_top)) check(anchor_after == anchor_before, 'paused height resize preserves position inside image row') Pause(false)
SetScroll(-1, true) local tall_bottom_before = GetInfo(296) MoveWorldWindow(40, 40, 1050, 500) local followed_short = GetInfo(296) SetScroll(-1, true) local short_bottom = GetInfo(296) check(followed_short == short_bottom, 'unpaused shorter window keeps transcript at bottom') MoveWorldWindow(40, 40, 1050, 800) local followed_tall = GetInfo(296) SetScroll(-1, true) local tall_bottom_after = GetInfo(296) record(string.format('SCROLL bottom tall_before=%d short=%d tall_after=%d', tall_bottom_before, short_bottom, tall_bottom_after)) check(followed_tall == tall_bottom_after and tall_bottom_after == tall_bottom_before, 'unpaused taller window follows the revised transcript bottom')
local wide_image_height = GetLineInfo(wide_image_line, 20) MoveWorldWindow(40, 40, 520, 800) local narrow_height = GetLineInfo(wide_image_line, 20) local first = GetWorldWindowPosition(1, false, true) record(string.format('RESIZE tall-short=%d tall-tall=%d wide-image-narrow=%d first=%dx%d', wide_height, taller_height, narrow_height, first.width, first.height)) check(narrow_height < wide_image_height, 'narrower world window scales wide image and its display height') assert_row_geometry('width resize keeps following paragraph adjacent to image') check(GetLineInfo(end_line, 19) == GetLineInfo(wide_image_line, 19) + narrow_height, 'width resize keeps final marker adjacent to wide image') MoveWorldWindow(40, 40, 1050, 800) check(DoCommand('NewWindow') == 0, 'second output window creation requested') phase = 'split' end) elseif phase == 'split' then safe_run(function() local second = GetWorldWindowPosition(2, false, true) record('SPLIT second=' .. (second and string.format('%dx%d', second.width, second.height) or 'nil')) check(type(second) == 'table' and second.width > 0, 'second output window exists for split-view compatibility') MoveWorldWindow(80, 80, 580, 560, 2) assert_row_geometry('first output view retains image layout after split') check(WindowInfo(miniwindow, 5), 'miniwindow remains shown after split') record('PASS compatibility checks completed; selection and transcript remain visible') phase = 'done' end) end end
